title: Affine weakly contractible hypercovers of qcqs pro-etale objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale site and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [def-weil-size-convention], and let $W\to X$ be a site object whose scheme $W$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There exists an augmented simplicial object $U_\bullet\to W$ in this site, with each $U_p$ affine and weakly contractible, which is a hypercover of $W$. Here weakly contractible means that evaluation $F\mapsto F(U_p)$ on sheaves of sets sends every epimorphism to a surjection. Hypercover means that for every $p\geq0$ the map from the representable sheaf of $U_p$ to its matching sheaf is an epimorphism. The matching sheaf in degree zero is the representable sheaf of $W$; in degree $p>0$ it is the sheaf of compatible proper faces of a $p$-simplex, the finite limit of the lower-degree representable sheaves indexed by proper faces. The face and degeneracy maps satisfy the simplicial identities. Representable sheaves here are the sheaves of scheme morphisms over $X$.
